sources.quote: TrES-2b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star TrES-2A located 750 light years away from the Solar System.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TrES-2. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: The planet was identified in 2011 as the darkest known exoplanet, reflecting less than 1% of any light that hits it.
